verdict.rationale: The API exposes the same independent index that powers Brave Search and documents endpoints for most of the search UI's surfaces: web, image, video, news, local/POI, rich verticals, suggestions, spellcheck, summarizer and answers. It also supports Goggles, search operators, SafeSearch, freshness and country filters. However, the docs never state UI/API parity, and there is no evidence that account or dashboard functions (key management, billing, usage) can be done through the API. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity claim or feature-mapping documentation, API access to dashboard/account management, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
